algorithm: Components share an exact geometric edge and matching UV endpoints, independent of normal splits. Global triangle AABB sweep + strict SAT tests interior overlap; shared boundaries allowed. Conservative island AABB gap search covers every pair within 32 effective pixels.
shader_reuse: UV0 is unique packed geometry. Shader multiplies UV0 by uniform extent then Frac reuses the same generated 448px swatch. Only the post-wrap sampling is intentionally shared.
scope: Every authored source mesh face; actual edge connectivity and global geometric overlap test, not face-plane group counts.
